name: Archfiend Beatdown
note: Era-appropriate Fiend build using the 2003-04 Archfiend/Pandemonium engine — docs/decks-archetypes.md §7. Names validated against cards.cdb.
manual:
**Game plan:** a DARK Fiend midrange deck built around `Pandemonium` — a Field Spell that waives every Archfiend's upkeep cost and free-recruits when one is destroyed, backed by dice-roll protection and equip-steal.

**Key cards / engine:** Pandemonium (cost-waiver + recruiter); Terrorking + Desrook loop; Falling Down theft; Mystic Tomato recruiter.

**How to pilot / combo lines:**
- **`Pandemonium` fixes the whole archetype's tax.** Every Archfiend must pay LP in your Standby Phase or be destroyed; Pandemonium waives that cost for both players, and when an Archfiend you control is destroyed by something other than battle, it adds a lower-Level Archfiend from Deck to hand — a free recruiter every time removal hits your board.
- **`Terrorking Archfiend` is the boss, and it needs a pawn.** It cannot be Normal/Flip Summoned unless you already control an Archfiend, so lead with `Vilepawn`/`Desrook`, or a body fetched by `Mystic Tomato` (Special Summons a DARK ≤1500 ATK monster on battle-death), then Normal-Summon Terrorking. It negates the effects of monsters it destroys by battle and rolls a die (2 or 5) to negate targeted effects.
- **`Desrook Archfiend` protects the king:** when your Terrorking is destroyed, discard Desrook from hand to Special Summon that Terrorking back from the GY — run both copies so Terrorking keeps standing back up. ⚠ unverified line (follows from card text, not a fetched primer).
- **`Falling Down` steals their best monster** — equip and take control of an opponent's monster, destroyed unless you control an Archfiend (your board always qualifies); the 800 LP Standby cost is fine in a deck that closes fast. `Archfiend's Oath` pays 500 LP to name a card and draw it off the top for selection.
- Beaters `Summoned Skull` (2500), `Beast of Talwar` (2400), `Archfiend Soldier`/`La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp` (1800/1800) give a clean DARK curve while the Archfiend engine sets up.

**Weaknesses:** `Skill Drain`/`Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror`-style effect negation turns off the whole engine and the dice protection; losing Pandemonium re-exposes every Archfiend to its upkeep tax; the dice-roll negation is genuinely low-reliability — treat it as upside, not a plan.
main: La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp
